name: worldmesh
description: Open network for independently hosted 3D worlds, connected across the web.

scripts.dev:hub: npm run build:runtime && npm run dev --workspace=apps/hub
scripts.dev:forest: npm run build:runtime && npm run dev --workspace=apps/forest
scripts.dev:mars: npm run build:runtime && npm run dev --workspace=apps/mars
scripts.dev:city: npm run build:runtime && npm run dev --workspace=apps/city
scripts.dev:medieval: npm run build:runtime && npm run dev --workspace=apps/medieval
scripts.dev:space: npm run build:runtime && npm run dev --workspace=apps/space
scripts.db:migrate:local: cd workers/auth && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply worldmesh --local --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state
scripts.build:hub: npm run build:runtime && npm run build --workspace=apps/hub
scripts.build:forest: npm run build:runtime && npm run build --workspace=apps/forest
scripts.build:mars: npm run build:runtime && npm run build --workspace=apps/mars
scripts.build:city: npm run build:runtime && npm run build --workspace=apps/city
scripts.build:medieval: npm run build:runtime && npm run build --workspace=apps/medieval
scripts.build:space: npm run build:runtime && npm run build --workspace=apps/space
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:runtime && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck:workers: npm run typecheck --prefix workers/auth && npm run typecheck --prefix workers/federation
scripts.test:workers: npm test --prefix workers/auth && npm test --prefix workers/federation
